guide.name: Layered editorial explanation
guide.description: A selected-scene study of photographic collage, subject identification and progressive speech emphasis, adaptable to new stories.
guide.origin: Generalized by Codex from three inspected scenes in the user-supplied FROM BILLIONS TO NOTHING OVERNIGHT reference; editable recipes come from our earlier authored studies.

rules.principle: Choose a composition that makes the new subject and its relationship to the words immediately clear.
rules.useWhen: A fact, subject or concept needs visual explanation.
rules.avoidWhen: An extra graphic would hide a meaningful live action or emotional expression.
rules.review: Check that every foreground image and label serves the declared new shot purpose.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Use bold high-contrast titles and unequal word/line emphasis to distinguish the main idea from context.
rules.useWhen: A name, claim or key spoken concept needs emphasis.
rules.avoidWhen: Every word would become equally loud or long wording would become unreadable.
rules.review: Inspect glyph proportions, hierarchy, line breaks, contrast and reading size with the actual new wording.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Use a clean subject silhouette and intentional overlaps to separate a featured object from its environment.
rules.useWhen: A photographic collage or object introduction benefits from distinct planes.
rules.avoidWhen: A reliable matte is unavailable or the whole action must remain visible.
rules.review: Inspect edges at native size; reject old subject-specific masks, halos and accidental rectangular borders.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Give graphic environments subtle photographic or tactile detail so large surfaces retain depth and character.
rules.useWhen: A generated graphic scene has otherwise empty surfaces.
rules.avoidWhen: The picture already has enough detail or grain would reduce legibility.
rules.review: Inspect surfaces and typography together; detail must support the new setting without covering letters.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Use a restrained cool graphic base with strong light/dark separation and a limited purposeful accent.
rules.useWhen: A collage, identity card or diagram needs a coherent graphic palette.
rules.avoidWhen: Natural footage or an established new brand palette would be harmed.
rules.review: Check palette relationships and subject/text contrast; natural footage can retain its own colors.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Hand visual emphasis between related information planes, letting the current idea become sharper or more prominent.
rules.useWhen: Several related concepts must be introduced in sequence.
rules.avoidWhen: There is only one idea or shifting focus would obscure an important face/action.
rules.review: Inspect consecutive frames across each handoff; new emphasis must remain readable during its hold.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Coordinate independently moving planes to give a graphic explanation a sense of camera movement and depth.
rules.useWhen: Layered objects or labels need a spatial relationship.
rules.avoidWhen: The footage already communicates the relationship clearly or the available renderer cannot express it.
rules.review: Inspect relative movement and edges through entry, hold and exit; a 2D approximation must be disclosed.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Build speech captions progressively, keeping earlier words readable while short entrances settle into place.
rules.useWhen: Speech carries the scene and captions improve comprehension.
rules.avoidWhen: An additional word animation would compete with a diagram or duplicate another headline.
rules.review: Inspect complete word entrances and settled holds; verify new source-clock cues separately from listening.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Use a cut or brief transition to mark a change of visual argument or return to the speaker.
rules.useWhen: A new scene purpose or phrase needs a clear context change.
rules.avoidWhen: The change would interrupt a continuous action, natural reaction or necessary explanation.
rules.review: Inspect frames on both sides of new cuts for continuity, appropriate context and clean phrase reset.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Give the main idea enough settled reading time, varying pacing between a graphic hold and speech-led phrase building.
rules.useWhen: A name, role, diagram or changing phrase needs time to be understood.
rules.avoidWhen: A fixed duration copied from the reference would rush or stall the new scene.
rules.review: Check new text length and explanation load against holds; sound alignment remains unknown until listened to.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

rules.principle: Keep meaningful expressions and actions visible while placing speech text in a quieter part of the picture.
rules.useWhen: A person is speaking or reacting on screen.
rules.avoidWhen: A full graphic explanation intentionally replaces the speaker for a brief beat.
rules.review: Inspect the new speaker/action throughout the shot and ensure moving captions stay clear of protected details.
rules.tolerance: Adapt the content, occupied area and duration to the new story; retain the stated hierarchy or movement relationship. Exact original font/camera values are unknown.

preserve: Readable settled holds and purposeful context changes
replace: All subjects, names, facts and headline wording
All source footage and photographic imagery
Graphic arrangement and accent colors when the new explanation requires it
adaptation.retime: Use the new transcript, actual speech cues, word lengths and reading load. Reference durations are examples; each new scene has its own entrance, hold and exit.
limitations: Selected scenes only; additional examples may change these rules.
Original fonts, materials, easing and 3D geometry remain uncertain.
Identity-card entrance is outside the inspected range.
No direct sound-design or speech-sync listening was performed.
Linked recipes are editable starting points with known 2D limits; this profile does not certify their fidelity or any new output.

recipes.purpose: Keep the new speaker visible with progressive emphasized speech.
recipes.avoidWhen: Captions compete with an important live detail or a full diagram.

recipes.purpose: Introduce the new subject or object using photographic separation and a clear label.
recipes.useWhen: An object/person needs a short visual introduction.
recipes.avoidWhen: New image/matte quality is poor or the live action is essential.

recipes.purpose: Emphasize a new claim or concept using depth-like image and headline movement.
recipes.useWhen: A brief graphic beat clarifies the new story.
recipes.avoidWhen: Repeated headline spectacle would distract from the explanation.
